entities.name: Warree Tarcha
entities.description: An old kithkin augur of Kinscaer in Shadowmoor, capable of potent white-mana protective spells; became Acting Cenn and was killed by Oona.

entities.name: Ashling the Destroyer
entities.description: Attacker of Kinscaer who killed Donal Alloway and was teleported to the edge of the world by Tarcha.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: The cenn of Kinscaer, killed by Ashling.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The fae queen who offered Kinscaer protection, then killed Tarcha and the kithkin of Kinscaer with her vines.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Returned to Kinscaer with his friends and was greeted by Oona's simulacrum of Tarcha.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: The people of Kinscaer, whose mindweft power Oona absorbed.

events.summary: Ashling attacks Kinscaer, distracts Tarcha, and kills Cenn Donal Alloway and others.
events.quote: Ashling killed the cenn Donal Alloway and a few other denizens of the doun.

events.summary: Tarcha teleports Ashling to the edge of the world.
events.quote: Tarcha then used her power to teleport Ashling to the edge of the world

events.summary: Oona offers Kinscaer protection in exchange for support against Ashling; Tarcha reluctantly agrees.
events.quote: Tarcha reluctantly agreed, believing that she was doing the best for her people.

events.summary: Oona kills Tarcha and everyone in Kinscaer with her vines and absorbs their power.
events.quote: Oona's help meant killing Tarcha and everybody in Kinscaer with her vines

events.summary: Oona's simulacrum of Tarcha greets Rhys and his friends and later battles Ashling.
events.quote: Oona's simulacrum of Tarcha then greeted Rhys and his friends after their return and later battled Ashling.

relations.quote: Oona's help meant killing Tarcha and everybody in Kinscaer with her vines

relations.note: Lived in the doun of Kinscaer
relations.quote: She lived in the doun of Kinscaer .
